function: Channel estimation of the 4D delay-Doppler-angle sparse channel in a hybrid analog-digital massive MIMO-OTFS LEO satellite downlink, using unrolled OAMP with self-attention (p. 1).
system: Massive hybrid analog-digital MIMO-OTFS LEO downlink; satellite 16x16 UPA, user ULA with 2-10 antennas; no RIS; 2 GHz S-band carrier (pp. 3, 5, 12).
method: Deep unrolled OAMP networks: BG-OAMPNet and SA-OAMPNet with self-attention and side information; supervised layer-by-layer training with NMSE loss, then joint refinement (pp. 8-10).
data_channel: Training and test sets generated with MATLAB 5G Toolbox from the 3GPP TR 38.811 NTN CDL-D channel model; 8,000 training and 200 test samples (p. 11).
test_conditions: Trained at 20 dB SNR, tested at 0-20 dB; mixed-speed training (1-6 Mach) tested at 2 and 4 Mach; Nr, pilot ratio, N varied (pp. 11-13).
baselines: Non-learned: MF-OAMP, 4DSOMP, PC-SBL, SBL-GAMP. Learned: OAMPNet-CNN [37], an unrolled OAMP with ResNet denoiser; own BG-OAMPNet as variant (p. 11).
metrics: NMSE versus SNR, pilot overhead, speed and receive antennas; BER with 4-QAM and LDPC; convergence per layer; inference time (pp. 11-14).
complexity: Table IV gives complexity order O(T(N'M'(M'+Nr)+Ca)) and inference time 0.0412 s (SA-OAMPNet), 0.0303 s (BG-OAMPNet), 0.0329 s (OAMPNet-CNN), 3090Ti GPU (p. 14).
q1_support: p. 11: "We examine the standardized channel for non-terrestrial networks as specified by 3GPP [18]"
q2_support: p. 13: "V = 1 ∼ 6 Mach during the training procedure) and test at V = 2 and V = 4 Mach". Test speeds lie inside the training range; no unseen scenario, band, dataset or antenna setting is tested.
q3_support: p. 11: "OAMPNet-CNN [37]: A deep unrolled OAMP network". Non-learned MF-OAMP, 4DSOMP, PC-SBL and SBL-GAMP are also compared, all on NMSE (Figs. 4, 5, 8, p. 12-13).
q4_support: p. 14: "the running time of SA-OAMPNet is about 30% longer than". Table IV on the same page lists the complexity order and running times.
q5_support: p. 11: "The training and testing datasets are generated using the MATLAB". Self-generated data; no code or dataset link or DOI appears in the paper.
notes: Area 4 rather than 2 or 6: the learned estimator recovers the delay-Doppler-angle channel of an OTFS link (p. 1). q1: ref [18] is 3GPP TR 38.811 (p. 15) and Table III lists NTN-CDL-D (p. 12); datasets are generated from it (p. 11). q2 borderline: the mixed-speed network is tested at 2 and 4 Mach, inside its 1-6 Mach training range (p. 13); SNR sweeps do not count and the training setting of the Nr, pilot-ratio and N sweeps is not stated. q3: OAMPNet-CNN is the learned baseline; BG-OAMPNet is the authors' own variant and is not counted. q5: data made with the commercial MATLAB 5G Toolbox, no link; the only URL is the 3GPP specification in ref [18].
